WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
), first_kept AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, o.avg_ratio AS overall_avg, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
), second_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
    SELECT f.ratio, f.above_overall, f.ratio - s.avg_ratio AS above_second
    FROM first_kept f
    CROSS JOIN second_average s
    WHERE f.ratio > s.avg_ratio
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(above_overall) AS average_amount_above_overall,
       AVG(above_second) AS average_amount_above_second
FROM final_kept;
